verdict.rationale: TaxJar documents uploading transactions through its API (createOrder) and connector integrations with many storefronts and processors (Amazon FBA, Shopify, Stripe, PayPal, Square, and others), and it targets businesses selling through multiple platforms, so multi-channel import is directly supported. However, historical API backfill is not explicitly documented, the cited plan caps integrations at 10, and nothing confirms that filings aggregate all channels. missing for 10: explicit historical backfill/bulk import documentation, evidence that filings aggregate every channel, no integration cap, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, transactions from every channel can be imported — API backfills and connector syncs from other processors and storefronts — so filings cover my whole business, not just one integration

citations.quote: You can use our API to get information on sales tax rates, categories or upload transactions.
Amazon FBA, BigCommerce, Ebay, Magento 2, Netsuite, PayPal, Shopify, Square, Stripe, Woocommerce
